2) 2 वर्ष बाद मान $= 176400 \times \frac{21}{20} \times \frac{21}{20} = \mathbf{1,94,481}$ (1,94,481)।

solution.keyConcept: Master Equation: (Rupees₁ / Qty₁ × Rate₁) = (Rupees₂ / Qty₂ × Rate₂)!

title.hi: विधि 1: 1 संतरे की दर से हल

Method 1: Per-Orange Price Scaling: Old SP of `1` $= 40 / 8 =$ ₹5 (`80%`).
For `120%` gain: New SP of `1` $= 5 \times \frac{120}{80} =$ ₹7.5.

Method 2: MDH-Style Rate Chain (4 sec): $\frac{\text{Rs}_1}{N_1 \times \text{Rate}_1} = \frac{\text{Rs}_2}{N_2 \times \text{Rate}_2} \implies \frac{40}{8 \times 80} = \frac{30}{N_2 \times 120} \implies \frac{1}{16} = \frac{1}{4\,N_2} \implies N_2 =$ **4**!
